title: Underroad Ram
text: Underroad Ram charges through thin ground with a crown of stone fused across its skull. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The road cracks several breaths before it arrives.

defeatReward.text: Underroad Ram is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
